summary.result: The research seeks to demonstrate that the CTCN TA provides the means and opportunities to build a solid CDM project based on a number of merits.
summary.background: It provides clear identification of country‐driven prioritized technology needs, an opportunity to build a strong network with key stakeholders, and an in‐depth understanding of the local situation and barriers to deploying the technology.
summary.method: In this study, researchers attempt to preemptively propose a strategy for how to approach this transition by linking the Technology Mechanism and CDM, based on empirical analysis of the CTCN TA‐CDM project to deploy desalination technology in a coastal area of Bangladesh.
